issue.title: Measure and speed up the bob-cli local-install build on the 8 GB M1 using runs.jsonl as the baseline
issue.description:
Proposed by bob-cli-i0.7 (docs-acceptance phase of epic bob-cli-i0, note #3), plan follow-up (b);
research R8 in research:202611/install_all_wait_and_whats_new/install_all_wait_and_whats_new.md.

Bryan runs `just install-all` on the 8 GB M1 about ten times a day and a bob-cli rebuild of the
local-install profile takes 7-12 minutes there. On athena (Linux) bob-cli-i0.7 measured 2m32s for
the initial real Cargo build and 1s for an incremental no-change install.

Now that `just install` records per-phase build history in
`~/.local/state/bob-cli/install-all/runs.jsonl` (step bob-cli, phases index/deps/crate/finish,
kind, toolchain, profile, incremental), investigate where the Mac build time goes:
`cargo build --timings --profile local-install` cold and warm on the M1, memory pressure/swap,
codegen-units/incremental/debug settings of the local-install profile, linker choice, and the
bob-obsidian crate's own compile share. Propose concrete changes with measured before/after.

task_type_fields.proposal: Profile the local-install Cargo build on the 8 GB M1 (cargo build --timings, cold and warm) and propose measured profile, linker, or crate-structure changes that cut install-all build time.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Epic bob-cli-i0 declared build speed out of scope (R8); it only added the per-host runs.jsonl history this investigation can use as its baseline.

issue.creation_reason: The install-all epic made the 7-12 minute Mac build pleasant to wait through but explicitly left making it faster (research R8) as a follow-up proposed by bob-cli-i0.7.
